rules: Green local repositories do not make an integration gate green.
Integration evidence must bind exact relevant revisions/builds/contracts.
Material contract drift returns affected integration gates to NEEDS_REVALIDATION.
A single-repository gate may record a real technical journey needed by the cross-repo program, but it does not substitute for multi-repository acceptance.
